To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the COMBINE approach is useful for the analysis of the binding of inhibitors to BACE-1, (2) the COMBINED models are predictive and robust, and (3) the COMBINES can provide useful insights into inhibitor design.

COMBINE analysis of 46 BACE-1 crystal structures provides two predictive QSAR models for the inhibition of BACE- 1 by 46 ligands, with q2 values of 0.741 and 0.794 and standard deviations of the error on the estimate of the cross-validation (SDEC) values of 0.521 and 0.41, respectively.
COMBINE analysis provides a powerful tool to identify and quantify key residues involved in ligand binding.
